source_limitations: Publisher-owned Cambridge Dictionary indexed results were observed through web search on 2026-11-03. Final review must revisit live publisher pages, reconcile sense and CEFR, independently check fluent Myanmar and original example grammar. No voice listening, physical iPhone or deployment evidence.

records.frozen_english_definition: Physical conflict or an attempt to stop an opponent.
